method: Set published final LayerNorm gain to -(1-0.3)/0.3 times the public gain. Scale the bias and inversely scale the visual projection in the same channel coordinates to keep the full standalone embedding exactly. The public-base interpolation gain vanishes at 0.3; an actual partner adds its own gain difference from the base. Preserve all parent A/B tensors. This is a separately declared readout range. No real or synthetic data, no partner, and no outcome-based adjustment.
evaluation: One frozen MNIST point. Same 64 images per task and coefficient training as the prior ProDistill comparison. Complete native, TA 0.5, author AGA target and both, and matched B+b replacement before TA or after AGA. Full target and SVHN partner, original batch replay. Report negative and positive outcomes.
limitation: Known readout symmetry. A location-aware attacker can canonicalize it. Cancellation is exact at the public-base proxy only and is not a statement about a fitted readout or arbitrary attack coefficient.
